validation.method: event-level: GitHub PR API merged_at + merged_by
validation.notes: Each checked merge event must exist, have merged_at inside the window, and have merged_by.login equal to the ranked account. Unknown (404/private) events are excluded from the rate, never counted as matches.

notes: `source` describes how much of the public GitHub event stream the newest daily shards actually contain (hourly files downloaded, events seen, bot events skipped). The score itself is one absolute number: public pushes, merged pull requests, closed issues, pull-request reviews, issue comments and releases added up over the rolling 12-month window. `signals` states how many ranked developers have each component above zero. Nothing is percentile-ranked, and no signal is inferred when the feed does not carry it. GitHub's own contribution count (which includes commits) is published separately by the GitHub API for the top 10,000 and never merged into this score.
